mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.data_scope, r.sort, r.status FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.sort

SELECT r.id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.data_scope, r.sort, r.status, r.remark, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE ur.role_id = r.id) AS user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_role_menu rm WHERE rm.role_id = r.id) AS menu_count FROM sys_role r WHERE r.deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.sort
SELECT rm.menu_id FROM sys_role_menu rm INNER JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id AND m.deleted = 0 WHERE rm.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY rm.menu_id
